questions.q: Beyond money, what does the summary say makes employees most loyal and motivated?
a: A shared purpose and set of values
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a common purpose makes staff feel part of something bigger than their material needs.

questions.q: What is the purpose of management's open-door policy at Disney?
a: Encouraging staff to raise problems openly
Allowing anyone to tour the offices
questions.why: Lesson 1 explains that transparency and an open door help employees speak up about challenges.

questions.q: Which side of a business does the summary describe as the art rather than the science?
questions.why: Lesson 2 separates the scientific side of assets and processes from the artistic side of people and culture.

questions.q: Why does the summary say Nokia lost its leading position?
a: Management ignored past mistakes and future trends
It spent too much on training its staff
It focused too heavily on customer feedback
It expanded into too many new markets
questions.why: Lesson 3 uses Nokia as a warning about leaders who fail to learn from the past and anticipate change.

questions.q: Where does the summary suggest executives should look for fresh perspectives?
questions.why: Lesson 3 recommends gathering opinions from employees, new hires, and stakeholders, then sorting through them.
